title: Mapped the trace viewer to a smoother workflow design
points: Failure case: production traces exposed the right fields but still felt like nested implementation logs, making it hard to follow the run step by step.
Flow logic changed: the trace viewer now opens on Plan, keeps one workflow stage active at a time, and uses a compact stage rail for Plan, Retrieve, Compute, Write, and Verify.

Retrieval design is now explicit: the Retrieve stage documents the BM25-first retrieval choice and shows how lexical FTS keeps source search fast, inspectable, and tunable without adding an embedding dependency.
Shipped result: trace review starts with workflow intent and compact cards, while raw router, lane, artifact, analyst, and source details remain available behind collapsed controls.
